g.text: DATA Wilding et al., NEJM 384:989 (2021); Wadden et al., JAMA 325:1403 (2021); Jastreboff et al., NEJM 387:205 (2022);

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono'; fill: #8c877d

g.text: Rubino et al., JAMA 325:1414 (2021). Values transcribed from the abstracts. Trials funded by the manufacturers.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono'; fill: #8c877d

g.text: NOTE Trials excluded people with diabetes. Gastrointestinal side effects were common, mostly mild to moderate.
